title: Thanksgiving in Laredo: markets, free turkeys, tree lighting and two morning runs
excerpt: From a fall market and a free turkey giveaway to the ninth annual tree lighting and two Thanksgiving morning runs, here is how Laredo is marking the holiday.
author: Webb Watch
image_alt: Thanksgiving decorations and autumn leaves in Laredo, Texas
content:
Laredo is easing into Thanksgiving week with a full slate of community events — a fall market, a free turkey giveaway, the city’s ninth annual tree lighting and two morning runs on Thanksgiving Day.

The Fall Market is scheduled for Saturday, Nov. 14, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Laredo College South Campus, 5500 S. Zapata Highway. The market will feature local vendors, food and family activities.

Also on Saturday, Nov. 14, the Turkey Giveaway will be held from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Laredo Police Department Headquarters, 4712 Maher Ave. Turkeys will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.

On Tuesday, Nov. 17, the City of Laredo will host its ninth annual Christmas Tree Lighting at 6 p.m. at the Laredo Center for the Arts, 500 San Agustin Ave. The free event will include live music, food vendors and a visit from Santa Claus.

On Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, Nov. 26, two runs are planned. The Guajolote 5K and 10K begins at 8:30 a.m. at 1320 Garden St. The Turkey Trot 5K starts at 9 a.m. at North Central Park, 10202 International Blvd.

Update — Nov. 22, 2026: The City of Laredo shared new details for the Guajolote 5K and 10K on Nov. 21. This year’s race is held in memory of Santiago Sanchez and is hosted by District 8 Council Member Alyssa Cigarroa in partnership with Hamilton Trophies. Registration is still open. Packet pickup is Wednesday, Nov. 25, from 5 to 7 p.m. at Peter Piper Pizza, 4600 San Dario Ave. The races start at 8:30 a.m. on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, at 1320 Garden St.
